text:
rachel_cs: Quick recap from Pendulum Finance onboarding call — customer surfaced 3 asks and a few friction points. Need product + eng prioritization before renewal next week.

rachel_cs: Asks: 1) per-customer model routing rules so non-sensitive flows go to lower-cost models; 2) exportable, tamper-evident prompt+response audit logs for compliance; 3) embeddings refresh controls (TTL + reindex window) and a simple toggle in Console for ops.

rachel_cs: Pain points: bursty tests caused ~3x bill spike on day 2; onboarding UI confusing when creating multi-key/service accounts; and docs unclear about fallback behavior when Dedicated capacity is degraded.

rachel_cs: Renewal risk: said "we like Redwood but need clearer cost controls or we'll pause the pilot". @sam_product @diego_engineer can you advise on quick wins we can promise?

tasha_csm: Echo — ops specifically asked for TTL controls so they don't reindex every night. Also requested an inline projected $ estimate when configuring routes.

sam_product: High level: separate workstreams. Quick wins: (A) surface per-route cost estimate in Console (heuristic-based) — low effort, immediate value; (B) embedding TTL toggle — medium effort but high unblock; (C) audit logs are enterprise-grade (immutable exports + retention).

sam_product: Suggestion: MVP audit export = weekly S3-compatible manifest with signed checksums. Iterate to KMS/HSM-backed immutability if needed. Thoughts @diego_engineer?

diego_engineer: Agree. Rough effort: cost-estimates UI ~2 dev days + PM; embedding TTL + toggle ~1 sprint (infra + Console + migration); audit export MVP ~3 sprints (auth, export pipeline, manifest, docs). Per-customer routing rules can reuse policy routing table but require UI + validation + safe canary rollout: backend ~2 sprints.

rachel_cs: Can we commit to cost-estimate UI + embedding TTL next sprint and start audit export as enterprise track? If yes Ill inform Pendulum and position timeline for renewal.

sam_product: Yes. I'll draft an RFC and slot UI + TTL for next sprint. Audit export -> enterprise backlog with longer lead. Will post RFC link here.

ops_bot: RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/1402 (Pendulum onboarding asks). Reviewers: sam_product, diego_engineer, rachel_cs. Draft ETA: 48h. :white_check_mark:

rachel_cs: Thanks. I'll tell Pendulum we can deliver cost UI + TTL toggle next sprint and that audit exports are tracked as enterprise work.

tasha_csm: Pendulum also asked for a 30m Console walkthrough of the cost view next Tue. I'll coordinate calendar 94 flagging as enablement request.

sam_product: Add enablement to acceptance criteria (30m walkthrough + quickstart doc).

rachel_cs: Great 94 closing the loop; will post customer quote after I confirm renewal meeting. :pray:
